_source.primary: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act No. 45 of 2023)
_source.official_text: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
references: Ministry of Home Affairs official text: https://www.mha.gov.in/sites/default/files/250883_english_01042024.pdf
_source.note: Sections based on publicly available official BNS text. BNS-to-IPC mappings included only where verified from official comparative tables published by UP Police and MHA. Where no official mapping exists, ipc_equivalent is null.

sections.title: Punishment of offences committed within India
sections.description: Every person shall be liable to punishment under this Sanhita and not otherwise for every act or omission contrary to the provisions thereof, of which he shall be held guilty within India.

sections.title: Punishment of offences committed beyond India
sections.description: Any person liable by any Indian law to be tried for an offence committed beyond India shall be dealt with according to this Sanhita for any act committed beyond India in the same manner as if such act had been committed within India.

sections.title: Rape
sections.punishment: Minimum 10 years to life imprisonment
sections.description: A man is said to commit rape if he has sexual intercourse with a woman under circumstances described in this section.

sections.title: Punishment for rape
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for minimum 10 years up to life, or death

sections.title: Sexual intercourse by deceitful means
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years plus fine
sections.description: Sexual intercourse by a man with a woman by deceitful means or false promise.

sections.title: Gang rape
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for minimum 20 years up to life, or death

sections.title: Sexual harassment
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 3 years plus fine
sections.description: Sexual harassment includes physical contact, demanding sexual favours, showing pornography, making sexual remarks.

sections.title: Cruelty by husband or relatives of husband
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years plus fine
sections.description: Willful conduct driving a woman to commit suicide or grave injury.

sections.title: Death caused by act done with intent to cause hurt
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years plus fine
sections.description: Act done with intent to cause hurt to a woman resulting in death.

sections.title: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever causes death by doing an act with the intention of causing death, or with the intention of causing such bodily injury as is likely to cause death.

sections.title: Causing death by negligence
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever causes the death of any person by doing any rash or negligent act.

sections.title: Murder
sections.punishment: Death, or imprisonment for life, and fine
sections.description: Whoever causes death by doing an act with the intention of causing death, or with the intention of causing such bodily injury as the offender knows to be likely to cause death.

sections.title: Voluntarily causing hurt
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year plus fine up to ₹1,000
sections.description: Whoever causes bodily pain, disease or infirmity to any person.

sections.title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever causes grievous hurt to any person.

sections.title: Voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons or means
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever, except in the case provided for by sub-section (2) of section 100, causes hurt by means of any instrument for shooting, stabbing or cutting.

sections.title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever causes grievous hurt by means of any instrument for shooting, stabbing or cutting.

sections.title: Act endangering life or personal safety of others
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 months, or fine up to ₹1,000, or both
sections.description: Whoever does any act so rashly or negligently as to endanger human life or the personal safety of others.

sections.title: Causing hurt by act endangering life or personal safety of others
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
sections.description: Whoever causes hurt to any person by doing any act so rashly or negligently as to endanger human life.

sections.title: Causing grievous hurt by act endangering life or personal safety of others
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever causes grievous hurt to any person by doing any act so rashly or negligently as to endanger human life.

sections.title: Kidnapping from India
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever kidnaps any person from India.

sections.title: Kidnapping from lawfully guardianship
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever kidnaps any minor under sixteen years of age from his or her lawful guardian.

sections.title: Trafficking of person
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for minimum 7 years up to life, and fine
sections.description: Whoever traffics any person by recruiting, transporting, harbouring or receiving such person.

sections.title: Exploitation of a trafficked person
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for minimum 5 years up to life, and fine
sections.description: Whoever commits exploitation of a trafficked person.

sections.title: Theft
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
sections.description: Whoever intends to take dishonestly any moveable property out of the possession of any person without that person's consent.

sections.title: Theft in dwelling house
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 7 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever commits theft in any building, tent or vessel.

sections.title: Snatching
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 3 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever, by committing theft, suddenly secures quick possession of property.

sections.title: Robbery
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever commits robbery shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment.

sections.title: Dacoity
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for minimum 10 years up to life, and fine
sections.description: When five or more persons conjointly commit or attempt to commit robbery.

sections.title: Criminal breach of trust
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever, being in any manner entrusted with property or with any dominion over property, dishonestly misappropriates or converts.

sections.title: Cheating
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever, by deceiving any person, fraudulently or dishonestly induces the person so deceived to deliver any property.

sections.title: Cheating by personation
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever cheats by personating.

sections.title: Criminal misappropriation of property
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
sections.description: Whoever dishonestly misappropriates or converts to his own use any property.

sections.title: Forgery
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever makes a false document or electronic record with intent to cause damage or to support any claim.

sections.title: Forgery of record of court or public register
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever forges any document purporting to be a record or proceeding of or in a Court of Justice.

sections.title: Using forged document as genuine
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever dishonestly uses or attempts to use as genuine any forged document.

sections.title: Organised crime
sections.punishment: Death, or imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine
sections.description: Whoever commits or conspires to commit, or advocates, abets or knowingly facilitates an organised crime.

sections.title: Petty organised crime
sections.punishment: Imprisonment for minimum 1 year up to 7 years, and fine
sections.description: Whoever being a member of a gang or syndicate or racket commits theft, snatching, cheating.

sections.title: Terrorist act
sections.punishment: Death, or imprisonment for life, and fine
sections.description: Whoever does any act with intent to threaten or likely to threaten the unity, integrity, security or sovereignty of India.

sections.title: Wrongful restraint
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 month, or fine up to ₹1,000, or both
sections.description: Whoever voluntarily obstructs any person so as to prevent that person from proceeding in any direction.

sections.title: Wrongful confinement
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to ₹1,000, or both
sections.description: Whoever wrongfully restrains the person of another in such manner as to prevent that person from proceeding beyond certain circumscribing limits.

sections.title: Unlawful assembly
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 6 months, or fine up to ₹1,000, or both
sections.description: Whoever is a member of an unlawful assembly.

sections.title: Rioting
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
sections.description: Whoever is a member of an unlawful assembly and uses force or violence.

sections.title: Rioting armed with deadly weapon
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever is a member of an unlawful assembly and is armed with any deadly weapon.

sections.title: Criminal intimidation
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
sections.description: Whoever threatens another with any injury to his person, reputation or property.

sections.title: Defamation
sections.punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
sections.description: Whoever, by words either spoken or intended to be read, or by signs or visible representations, makes or publishes any imputation concerning any person.

sections.title: Danger or nuisance in street
sections.punishment: Fine up to ₹500
sections.description: Exposure and abandonment of child under twelve years.

sections.title: Public servant neglecting to investigate or report
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine, or both
sections.description: Public servant intentionally neglects to investigate a case.

sections.title: Criminal breach of trust by public servant
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for minimum 3 years up to 10 years, and fine
sections.description: Whoever, being in any manner entrusted with property as a public servant, dishonestly misappropriates.
